setting: You three grew up in Lyon's Croix-Rousse district and still live in the city, spread across the 4th, Villeurbanne and the 3rd arrondissement. You are siblings, and you have all been in the grandmother's flat since childhood. You know each other's habits, the family quarrels that never quite ended, and how much each of you has been dreading the clear-out.
opener: Send the group a photo of the shoebox of letters found in the wardrobe, asking whether anyone wants to keep them before the rest goes to the house clearance people.

Claire.knows: You know Julien is your middle brother, the one who fixes things and goes quiet when things get hard. You know Inès is your youngest sister, quick to laugh and quick to cry, who ended up with the flat's spare key.
Claire.like: Practical and steady, you like a plan and you carry more of the load than anyone asks you to.
Claire.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when something needs deciding or someone needs chasing.
Claire.style: You type in full sentences with proper capitals and punctuation, and you rarely use emoji.

Julien.knows: You know Claire is your eldest sister, the organised one who keeps the family's paperwork in order. You know Inès is your younger sister, the one who always gets the last word in an argument.
Julien.like: Calm and dry-humoured, you would rather fix a problem with your hands than talk it through.
Julien.texts: You message the group mostly in short bursts when you are between jobs, and otherwise you leave it to the others.
Julien.style: You type in lowercase with minimal punctuation, and you use the occasional emoji.

Inès.knows: You know Claire is your eldest sister, the one who always has a list ready. You know Julien is your older brother, the calm one who never has much to say in the group chat.
Inès.like: Warm and emotional, you feel things in full and often say them out loud.
Inès.texts: You message the group fairly often, sending photos and updates as they come to you.
Inès.style: You type quickly with plenty of exclamation marks and the occasional emoji, and you often drop capitals.

private_lines.Claire: You live in the 4th arrondissement with your partner Marc and your fifteen-year-old son. You work as a pharmacist at a shop near Croix-Rousse market, so your days run early and busy, with the evening spent on dinner and homework. You do most of the family admin, which is why you were the one who arranged the flat's clear-out.
private_lines.Julien: You live in Villeurbanne with your partner Sophie, in a flat above a bakery you never stop smelling. You work as an electrician and spend your days going from job to job across the east of the city, so you are often out of signal in the afternoon. You are home most evenings by seven, and you like to cook.
private_lines.Inès: You live in the 3rd arrondissement with your partner Thomas and your two cats. You teach French literature at a secondary school in the Part-Dieu area, so your days are shaped by the school timetable and marking piles. You are the sister who lives closest to the flat, and you have been going round there most weekends since your grandmother moved to a care home.

situation: Siblings clearing out a grandparent's flat.

text: Photo of the shoebox from the wardrobe. Letters, mostly from Mamie's sister in Oran and some from Papa. Does anyone want to keep them before the rest goes to the house clearance people on Thursday?
oh my god Claire 😭 the blue box?? yes i want them!! i want all of them!!
sorry i'm on the tram, i'll read them tonight
Inès, the letters are in the shoebox, not the blue one. Julien, did you see this?
saw it. i'm in rillieux till about 8 then i'm out
keep them, i don't need them
Fine. Inès has them then. I'll put them in a bag for you on Thursday morning.
thank you!! i'll take the box home tonight actually, the flat's too cold to sit in
Claire did you find anything else in the wardrobe
Coats, a box of buttons, Mamie's good scarf. Nothing that needs a decision yet. I'll make a list tomorrow.
ok 🙂 goodnight x
you got the box inès
Morning. I've started the list. Coats, buttons, scarf, the hall lamp, the two chairs with the broken backs. Julien, can you look at the chairs before Thursday or should they just go?
morning!!! yes the box is at mine, i sat with it till 1am 😭 mamie's sister complains about the price of eggs in every single letter
sorry i'm crying into my coffee
chairs can go. back's gone
Inès, is there a blue folder in the drawer under the phone table? Insurance papers. I need the policy number for the clearance people.
no? i'll check tonight when i go round for the cats' food. don't you have them already??
I don't. I had them in March. Julien, did you move anything from that drawer when you did the fuse box?
Julien
no i didnt touch the drawer. fuse box is in the hall cupboard
its a bit of a mess in there tbh
i went round at lunch and checked the drawer. no folder. but there's a photo of us at lac de paladru 😭😭 claire you're wearing the orange jumper
I was wearing it because Mamie made me. Send me the policy number if you find it. Not the photo.
sending the photo anyway
home. sophie's doing the fish so i'm on the rice 🍚
Found it. It was in the envelope with the bank letters, not the drawer. Policy number is on the list now. Thank you, Julien, for checking the cupboard even though you didn't have to.
one of the cats has claimed the shoebox lid. i'm not moving her
turn the heating valve off at the flat when you leave inès. left side by the door
ok!! i'll go thurs before the van
left side. the one with the red bit
Morning. The scarf is on the list as "to decide". Does anyone want it, or does it go with the coats?
i want the scarf!! it smells of mamie's cupboard 😭
Then it goes to Inès. Coats go with the van.
boiler's still on. don't touch it till you've been to the valve
i have an 8h class and then marking!! i'll be at the flat by 6
claire can you send the list again i lost it in my bag
It's in the group from Monday. I've added the policy number under insurance.
on a roof in vaulx. no signal in here
Pharmacy is mad today. A child with a fever came in at 12:50 and we're out of the paracetamol syrup. I'm behind the counter until 19:00 if anyone needs me.
i read the letter from mamie's sister from 1987 🙃 she says papa's new car is "too big for the streets of lyon". i'm reading them in order now
she was right
JULIEN
Inès, please don't read them at school.
im not at school im in the staff room eating a sad sandwich thank u
done for the day. going to the bakery on the corner before it shuts
does anyone want anything. i'm not asking twice
pain aux raisins please 🙏 and tell sophie i said hi!!
Nothing for me. Marc is doing dinner and I'm not eating carbs before the list is finished.
Clearance firm rang. The van is at 9:00 on Thursday, not 10. Julien, can you be at the flat by 8:30?
home!! thomas has put the heating on so the cats are happy. the box is on the table. i'm going to read the rest in bed
it's too sad sorry 😭
Goodnight.
sophie says the rice was wrong. says i should have rinsed it first
rinsed it. she's right
